short: Irrational cubic fourfolds with a K3

title.title: Cubic fourfolds with a K3 category that are still irrational
title.subtitle: Claim: a very general cubic in $\mathcal C_d$, $d$ large, is irrational though it has a K3 category

plain: Some 4D cubic shapes pass the test for being 'unfoldable' into flat space, yet cannot be unfolded

beats.text: Kuznetsov: a cubic fourfold is rational exactly when its K3 category is geometric
Known rational cubics, such as those on $\mathcal C_{26}$, sit in the middle (schematic)
The claim: very general cubics on most $\mathcal C_d$ fill the region the conjecture empties

steps: Suppose such a cubic were rational
Count K3-type pieces a birational map creates or destroys, two ways
The counts disagree, so it cannot be rational

achievement.label: Kuznetsov's rationality conjecture (2010)
achievement.context: Before: no cubic fourfold was even known to be irrational until 2025
achievement.note: Only for $d$ above an ineffective threshold $d_0$

verify.detail: No Lean; 62 pages, building on brand-new 2025 work on Hodge atoms
verify.ourCheck: We read the claim and caveats; we did not check the proof

voice.text: Kuznetsov predicted a cubic fourfold is rational exactly when its K3 category is geometric.
Assume it is rational, count K3 pieces two different ways, and the counts disagree.
Claimed: most such cubics are irrational anyway.
